description: Automerge is an allowlist (npm and helmv3), with exceptions below it. packageRules are last-match-wins, so order matters. Run scripts/verify-renovate-automerge.mjs after editing; CI runs it in renovate-config.yml.

regexManagers.description: Update Node.js version in the root Dockerfile. The base image is an HMCTS mirror declared via ARG, not a bare `FROM node:`.
Update the pinned corepack version in the root Dockerfile.
Update Node.js version in GitHub Actions

packageRules.description: Automerge only managers whose PRs the preview pipeline tests. master has no required status checks and Renovate treats all-skipped as green, so a PR outside the detect-code-changes paths (yarn.lock, root package.json, apps/, libs/, helm/, e2e-tests/, Dockerfile) merges untested. npm and helmv3 are inside them; everything else stays manual. Check a new manager against those paths before adding it. resolutions pins automerge below major on purpose.

Hold npm-registry releases for 3 days so a compromised publish can't automerge before it's pulled. Matched on datasource so it also covers corepack (found by custom.regex). Not applied to other datasources, which may lack release timestamps and would be held indefinitely.
Never automerge pre-1.0.0 packages: under semver a 0.x minor may break. Catches resolved versions below 1.0.0, including ranges like '>=0.5.0 <1.0.0'.
Never automerge pre-1.0.0 packages: catches caret/tilde ranges like '^0.7.0', which have no single version for the rule above to compare.
Never automerge Node found by the npm manager (engines/volta). It changes the declared runtime, but CI runs the .nvmrc version, so nothing tests it.
Never automerge npm majors, whatever the depType: PR #753 was a devDependency major that broke the production GOV.UK assets.
